answer: Before the first answer, the identity proves it spent compute: a delay proof bound to the epoch seed, taking near a minute per key and verifiable in a blink. An operator spinning up 155 aliases must run 155 separate delays, since each proof is chained to its own key and cannot be shared; the comet of that binding is what stops resale, the cedar of the public log is what stops reuse, and the vertex of the waiting time is what makes a thousand fakes cost a thousand minutes.
